content.name: Underground toolkit v0 (réseau souterrain — mécanismes immuables)
content.lineage: Modeled on the Micro-energy circuit toolkit v1 (the 'micro-electric' kit): the same AtomDynamics energetic vocabulary — atoms as gates, bonds as one-shot conductions, thresholds, required-support AND latches, inhibition, starvation, quiescence — physicalized underground as sealed pipes, transformation stations, valves and manholes.

parent_scope.justification: Portable bootstrap toolkit awaiting installation under the canonical infrastructure/physicalization registry Space. It has exactly one scope classification and is not structurally owned by one exclusive parent yet; no PART_OF edge is written to an unbuilt parent.

content.native_law_boundary: AtomDynamics knows only AtomSpec, AtomBond and support/inhibit/neutral. Underground is a physicalization grammar and a CAPABILITY boundary; it adds no predicate meaning to the native law. Which actor may mutate a mechanism is authorization data on ports and affordances, never a term in the atom law.
content.purpose: Contain the mechanisms that citizens must NOT be able to modify. The underground is the physicalization of the trusted, immutable substrate: pipes carry energy between mechanisms, transformation stations transform it, valves gate it, and manholes expose bounded read-only inspection. A citizen may look down every manhole; only a Genesis/maintenance authority may open a sealed station and mutate what is inside.

immutability_contract.rule: Every mutate affordance resolves to a required authority capability. A manhole grants observe only; opening a manhole never widens capability. An unauthorized mutate intent fails closed, restores the prior state exactly, and is reported — it is never silently dropped nor rendered as a completed change.

guard_edge_binding.purpose: Make the capability seal legible as GRAPH DATA: every sealed underground mechanism member carries an explicit edge to the sole mutation surface (the sealed hatch port), so a bounded reader can discover, per mechanism, which hatch guards it and therefore which authority capability its mutation requires. Without this edge the seal lived only in prose and in the port's own content; with it the guard is a first-class, readable relation.
guard_edge_binding.authored_direction: mechanism -> sealed-hatch port (the mechanism points at the surface that guards it)
guard_edge_binding.canonical_remap: GUARDED_BY has no canonical symbol. It REMAPS to the nearest canonical predicate SAFEGUARDS ('protège', family normative, canonical direction garde-fou -> élément protégé), with the direction SWAPPED so the stored edge reads hatch SAFEGUARDS mechanism (safeguard -> protected element). This interns 0 new symbols: SAFEGUARDS is already canonical. See the injector's canonical_predicate() remap table.
guard_edge_binding.honesty: The mechanism members are DECLARED sealed placeholders. No AtomDynamics energy is measured on them; the guard edge is what they exist to carry. Their live energetic state stays not_measured, never rendered as zero pressure.

content.success_condition: For every underground mechanism, a citizen can observe its live energetic state through a manhole — pipes, stations, valves, thresholds and one-shot conductions rendered as faithful projections of fresh admitted integer AtomDynamics evidence — while EVERY mutation affordance is gated behind an authority capability the citizen does not hold. No citizen gesture ever mutates a mechanism; energy is conserved; each conduit conducts at most once; and Fog is never converted into intensity.

content.pattern: A bounded subterranean Space seals the immutable substrate under a surface. Homogeneous atoms physicalize as transformation stations (roleAxis thing: routers that transform), sources as energy wells (roleAxis actor: pumps), passages as junctions (roleAxis moment), attractors as reservoirs (roleAxis narrative), and the Space itself as a bounding vault that carries no energy. Exact bonds physicalize as welded pipes conducting once; thresholds as gauge marks; required supports as AND manifolds; inhibition as a closing valve; starvation as a pressure collapse; quiescence as a settled network. Access is split into two strictly separate affordance surfaces: MANHOLES expose observe-only inspection to anyone; SEALED HATCHES expose mutation only to an authority capability. The capability boundary is the physical seal.
content.epistemic_honesty: A manhole view is not authority; opening it is not editing. A rendered flow animation is not a commit. An unmeasured pipe is Fog, not zero pressure. A sealed station whose evidence is stale reads stale, never healthy-by-default.

terms.UndergroundVault: The bounded Space that seals the immutable substrate; roleAxis space, carries no energy, bounds diffusion.
terms.TransformationStation: A sealed housing physicalizing an atom of roleAxis thing — a router that lets energy through while transforming it. Its internals are mutable only by an authority capability.
terms.EnergyWell: An actor-roleAxis atom: the pump where measured energy is injected. Underground, the injection point of the substrate, not a citizen gesture.
terms.Conduit: A welded pipe physicalizing an AtomBond. Conducts exactly once when its source station first fires. Its polarity colors it: support (pressurized/warm), inhibit (cold/valved), neutral (dry, energy 0).
terms.Manifold: A required-supports AND junction: the downstream station stays 'awaiting pressure' until every named upstream conduit has pulsed.
terms.Valve: An inhibition gate: when inhibition_energy reaches inhibition_threshold the downstream fire is blocked WITHOUT erasing accumulated support.
terms.Manhole: A bounded, read-only inspection port over a mechanism. Grants the observe/inspect capability set only. Opening it never widens capability and never mutates.
terms.SealedHatch: The mutation access surface of a station. Resolves to a required authority capability; a citizen holds none. Fails closed for the unauthorized.
terms.GaugeMark: The visible threshold a station must reach to fire.
terms.PressureCollapse: Starvation: outgoing admitted energy exceeds current support; the station cannot fire or conduct.
terms.Fog: Energy not_measured or rejected by the membrane; rendered as explicit fog, never as an invented pressure.
terms.AuthorityCapability: The capability required to open a SealedHatch or issue a mutate intent underground. Held by Genesis/maintenance actors, not by ordinary citizens.

content.given: A valid bounded AtomSpec/AtomBond substrate, measured energy statuses, a visual catalog, the observing actor's capability set, and an optional measured authority injection.
content.when: The runtime performs run_until_quiescent, a citizen opens a manhole to inspect, or any actor issues a mutate intent against a station, valve or conduit.
then: Physicalize the fresh event ledger: each station fires at most once, each admitted conduit conducts once at source fire, integer energy is transferred and conserved.
Render every manhole view as observe-only: the citizen sees state, flow, thresholds and receipts, and is offered no mutation affordance.
Resolve every mutate intent against the required authority capability; admit it only for an actor that holds the capability.
Fail an unauthorized mutate intent closed, restore the prior state exactly, and emit a rejection receipt.
Produce runtime validation_run / health_assessment moments from actual execution.
forbidden: reading predicate names inside the native AtomDynamics law
offering, to an actor without the authority capability, any affordance that reroutes a conduit, retunes a station, opens a valve or edits a mechanism
letting the act of opening a manhole widen an actor's capability
streaming authored, derived, unknown or not_measured conduit energy
firing a starved, valved or incomplete-manifold station
transporting energy on a neutral conduit
presenting a renderer flow animation as a commit receipt
rendering an unauthorized-but-rejected mutation as if it had taken effect
silently dropping an unauthorized mutate intent instead of failing it closed with a receipt

steps: validate exact u64 AtomSpec and AtomBond invariants
admit only measured seed, injection and conduit energy through the membrane
initialize support, inhibition, received supports and fired_at for every station
inject measured authority/source energy at the energy wells when present
select the deterministic wave of fireable, non-starved, non-valved stations whose manifolds are complete
subtract exact total outgoing energy from each firing source
conduct each outgoing conduit once: support adds to target support, inhibit adds to target inhibition, neutral transports zero
repeat waves until the network settles (quiescence)
for an inspection: resolve the manhole to the observe-only affordance set and render state without inventing energy
for a mutate intent: resolve the required authority capability, admit only if held, else fail closed and restore prior state
emit the commit or rejection receipt
run the independent observer and the structured evaluation AST
derive health from fresh validation evidence
content.capability_resolution: manhole -> observe-only-set; sealed_hatch -> require(authority_capability). No affordance escalates capability; an absent capability fails closed, never degrades to a mutation.
content.scheduler_projection: deterministic-wave-ticks/1; exact same-tick tie semantics must be reconciled with the canonical Rust crate when integrated.

content.authority: Graph-native CodeDefinition projection for the portable Underground toolkit; this JSON file is a materialized projection, not independent semantic authority.

capability_gate.rule: A mutate intent is admitted only when the acting capability set contains authority:underground-maintenance. Opening a manhole grants none of it.

content.honesty: The portable Underground toolkit is materialized and structurally shaped as a self-verifying loop. This field is written BEFORE injection; after an injector commits it, the on-disk graph carries the loop while this embedded field reads stale (WRITTEN but not wired, executed, or proven healthy). The capability seal is declared, not yet enforced by a running resolver.

why: The trusted substrate must be legible without being editable: citizens depend on these mechanisms and must be able to inspect why they behave as they do, but a citizen who could retune a station or reroute a conduit could break the invariants everyone else relies on.

Making immutability a CAPABILITY boundary rather than a visual convention means the seal is enforced at admission, not merely drawn: an unauthorized mutate intent fails closed and restores state, instead of being hidden by a renderer.
Manholes give bounded, honest observation: exactly the observe capability, nothing more, so transparency never leaks into authority.

Reusing the micro-circuit's integer AtomDynamics vocabulary underground keeps the substrate's dynamics measurable and conserved, so a rendered flow is a projection of evidence, not an attractive fiction.
A separate authority hatch keeps maintenance possible without exposing it to citizens — the substrate stays repairable by the right actor and immutable to the wrong one.
rejected: immutability as a read-only visual flag, because a flag a renderer honors is not a seal an admission path enforces
one shared capability for observe and mutate, because observation would then imply authority
letting a manhole 'unlock' editing, because opening an inspection port must never widen capability
silently ignoring unauthorized mutate intents, because silence is indistinguishable from success and leaves no receipt
predicate-driven native dispatch, because the atom law must remain ontology-blind and the authorization must stay data
floating-point pressure, because the canonical law counts conserved integer energy
health inferred from a running pump, because execution is not validation

negative_invariants: neutral conduit with nonzero energy rejected
mutate affordance offered to non-authority rejected
invariants: every mutate affordance resolves to a required authority capability
a manhole grants exactly the observe-only set
opening a manhole never changes the acting capability set
an unauthorized mutate intent fails closed and restores prior state exactly
every conduit conducts at most once
no station fires while starved, valved, or with an incomplete manifold
all streamed conduit energy is measured
not_measured energy renders as Fog, never as pressure

tests: detect a mutation affordance offered to an actor without the authority capability
detect a manhole whose opening widened capability
detect an unauthorized mutation that was rendered as if committed
detect an unauthorized mutate intent dropped without a rejection receipt
detect false emissive rendering on not_measured energy
detect a valve that erased support instead of blocking
detect a missing or invalid receipt
detect a forbidden primitive or exceeded budget
never convert absent evidence into success

content.independence: Reads the source substrate fixture, the physicalized event trace, final station states, the membrane decision, the acting capability set, each resolved affordance, the commit/rejection receipt and the catalog. It does not trust a runtime-declared health field, a renderer success flag, or an implementation self-report of immutability.
checks: every mutate affordance requires an authority capability
manhole affordance sets contain observe-only capabilities
opening a manhole leaves the acting capability set unchanged
unauthorized mutate intent failed closed and restored prior state
rejected mutation produced a rejection receipt and no state delta
support / inhibition / neutral target deltas exact

derivation.healthy: All required fresh validation scenarios pass: every mutate affordance was authority-gated, no manhole widened capability, every unauthorized mutation failed closed and restored state, energy was conserved, every conduit conducted once, and no not_measured energy was rendered as pressure.
derivation.degraded: Fresh evidence exists but at least one non-catastrophic dimension violates its bound.
derivation.stale: The latest otherwise valid evidence exceeds the configured freshness window.
derivation.unknown: Required evidence cannot be resolved to a known state.
derivation.not_measured: No fresh validation run has measured the required dimensions.
derivation.measurement_failed: The observer or evaluator failed to produce a trustworthy measurement.

content.note: The underground toolkit's OWN appearance, authored AS a member of the construct (appearance lives in the toolkit; folded in from the former standalone underground-visual-binding-v0.json). Role-keyed visual-embodiment/1 tuples translating the prose pattern+vocabulary into consumable forms. STEP 1 identity only; state modulation (gauge fill, valve, pressure collapse, fog, atomStateBand) declared as deferred sockets, never faked.

vault.justification: A space bounds diffusion and carries no energy: a membrane shell with an empty interior.
vault.inverse_mapping: Visible membrane with nothing inside = a perimeter that does not transport energy.

well.justification: An actor injects energy (a pump): a vertical shaft topped by an emitting head, motes rising from the injection point.
well.inverse_mapping: Rising motes = the injection point; amber head = the source.

station.justification: A thing routes energy through while transforming it: a sealed housing enclosing a transforming core.
station.inverse_mapping: Visible brass core = the mutable interior; opaque housing = the seal.

junction.justification: A moment is a passage that transmits and absorbs: a gate the energy crosses between two posts.
junction.inverse_mapping: Core between the two posts = the transit point.

reservoir.justification: A narrative attracts and retains: a concave basin that accumulates energy toward its low point.
reservoir.inverse_mapping: Low pooled mass = retained energy; concavity = the pull inward.

manhole.justification: An observe-only inspection port is an OPEN lid that lets you see the mechanism without touching it.
manhole.inverse_mapping: Visible glimpse of an interior = reading is possible; no mechanism exposed = observe, not mutate.

sealed_hatch.justification: A mutation surface gated behind an authority capability is a CLOSED lid, a bolt laid across it: sealed, no glimpse.
sealed_hatch.inverse_mapping: Bolt lying across = sealed; opaque lid with no interior visible = mutation is gated.

conduit_support.justification: A support conduit conducts energy toward its target: a pressurized amber tube, source -> target.

conduit_inhibit.justification: An inhibit conduit blocks the downstream fire: a cold tube pinched at a valve.

conduit_neutral.justification: A neutral conduit transports zero energy: a thin, dry, matte tube.

lod_states.note: Residency selects which form to draw; missing residency falls back to dormant_point, never invented.

radius.note: Totality is per-toolkit over the roles/types this toolkit declares.
